items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Carlos worked very closely with GAC, you know, because he had Nat, Peggy Lee, Mel Torme, Stan Kenton, all of these people were GAC.

ctx.x: So I thought about it and I thought about it, and in the back of my mind I thought, well, now, how in the world can I afford to go to New York. Well, the money really that Mr. Josephson was offering wasn't much, you know, and I got to thinking to myself, now, I can't go to New York and live with that little money. But Mr. Dexter was saying, "Well, I think you should go and try it and see what happens, because you'll be able to make other contacts." In the meantime, he says, "I'm going to talk to Carlos Gastel ,…

And sure enough, he did talk to Carlos Gastel and GAC, and of course Carlos worked very closely with GAC, you know, because he had Nat, Peggy Lee, Mel Torme, Stan Kenton, all of these people were GAC. So anyway, he talked to Mr. Gastel and got him interested in me, and well, it just started,

it just happened that way. However, I did agree to go to New York and work for Barney Josephson for the first, you know, for eight weeks at least. So after that time, then Carlos Gastel took over as my manager, and that's when things began to happen.
